IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION 
WRIT PETITION NO.5544 OF 2025 
Govind Ishwar Purbiya ... Petitioner 
versus
The Asstt. Commissioner of Police and Anr. … Respondents 
WITH
WRIT PETITION NO.5545 OF 2025 
Jilson Anthony Sunar ... Petitioner 
versus
The Asstt. Commissioner of Police and Anr. … Respondents 
WITH
WRIT PETITION NO.5550 OF 2025 
Divesh Kiran Kadam ... Petitioner 
versus
The Asstt. Commissioner of Police and Anr. … Respondents 
WITH
WRIT PETITION NO.5551 OF 2025 
Rutik Sanjay Pol ... Petitioner 
versus
The Asstt. Commissioner of Police and Anr. … Respondents 
Mr. Prashant V. Malik, for Petitioners. 
Mrs. R.S.Tendulkar, APP for State in WP No.5544 of 2025. 
Mr. P.P.Malshe, APP for State in WP Nos.5545, 5550 and 5551 of 2025. 
CORAM:  N.J.JAMADAR, J. 
    DATE : 4 NOVEMBER 2025 
P.C. 
1. Heard the learned Counsel for the parties. 
2. The challenge in these Petitions is to orders dated 25 August 2025
passed by the Deputy Commissioner of Police, whereby action has been
SSP                                                                                                            1/2
2025:BHC-AS:47004

16 wp 5544 of 2025.doc
taken against the Petitioners under Section 55 of the Maharashtra Police Act,
1951, thereby externing the Petitioners from Palghar, Thane, Mumbai and
Mumbai Suburban Districts for a period of one year. 
3. Learned Counsel for the Petitioners submits that, the Petitioners have
preferred  statutory  appeals  before  the  Divisional  Commissioner  on  26
September  2025.   However,  no  date  for  hearing  of  the  said  appeals  is
scheduled.  
4. As the Petitioners have filed Appeals, it would be expedient that the
appellate authority hears the appeals as expeditiously as possible.  
5. The Appellate Authority is requested to take up the appeals preferred
by the Petitioners, copies of which are annexed at Exh.D to the Petitions, for
hearing on 18 November 2025 and decide the said appeals as expeditiously
as possible, and, preferably within a period of two months thereafter. 
6. Writ Petitions stand disposed. 
( N.J.JAMADAR, J. )
SSP                                                                                                            2/2
